d:
Smriti Mandhana reveal the mindset, sacrifices, and mental battles behind becoming India's biggest cricket star.
She explains:
• What Her Coach's manifestation ritual looked like and why Smriti credits it for shaping her career
• How Smriti handles mistakes on the field and the single phone call that completely reset her mindset
• Why she believes staying content and putting others first is a competitive advantage, not a weakness
• How to handle pressure and anxiety as a cricketer performing at the international level
